name: Circuit Paul Ricard (Grand Prix Circuit)

career.lengthSource: Circuit Paul Ricard official site | https://www.circuitpaulricard.com/
career.layoutCall: Grand Prix layout with the Mistral chicane, 15 turns, 1C-V2 (5.842 km nominal; 2023 timing sheets print 5.822 km): Euroformula Open, July 2023 (research notes item 1, from the FRECA and GT Open timing of the same weekends). OSM loop through both 'Chicane Nord' ways on the Mistral straight (5853 m); OSM's loop without the chicane measures 5771 m, the 13-turn 1A-V2 (5.770 km). Driving Center, skid pan and test areas excluded; the 'Stand' ways drawn as the pit lane.
